strings.name: Cristiano Amon
strings.summary: Amon began with Brazilian electrical engineering and telecom work, first joining Qualcomm in 1995. He led semiconductor and product operations before becoming CEO in 2021. He helped advance mobile chips, 5G and Snapdragon, and expanded into automotive, PCs and data centers. These technologies are collective achievements; roadmaps and future shipment targets are not completed outcomes.
